term: no cause versus no existing cause of the spacetime whole
definition: Analyst scope comparison reusing the existing Ontic, spacetime Frame, UniverseHasExistingCause and UniverseUncaused. Causing retains the old productive/dependence-or-conservation-of-existence reading, not temporal beginning, explanation tokens, parthood or incoming influence. Generic Ontic does not enforce endpoint existence; selected-whole-causer actuality is a separate weak policy, obtained from the existing full causal-endpoints policy without adding it to the signature. No transitivity, asymmetry or well-foundedness is assumed. An absent-causer edge assignment is deliberately outside intended productive-cause actuality, not a claim such a causer is possible in reality. The actual and no-edge controls keep candidates populated and the same whole. Actual applicability and any inference that the whole has a cause remain OPEN.
note: Preserves the full brute-universe source/candidate position while distinguishing its stronger no-edge claim from the exact no-existing-cause complement. No new historical attribution or real-world causality established.
